processing_notes: Source states: 'le cholera s'est remis a flamber au lendemain de la tentative de coup d'Etat, en septembre 2002, avec plus de 600 cas enregistres.' - interpreted as 600 sCh cases. Recorded at AFR::CIV::Abidjan rather than at commune level precisely so it is not mistaken for Yopougon commune incidence; a modeller using this row must treat it as a prison-population outbreak. Dates: the source ties the flare-up to the aftermath of the attempted coup d'etat of 19 September 2002 but gives no end date, so TR is set to year-end 2002 and the period should be read as approximate. No death count given. Context from the same source: 'Dans l'environnement insalubre et surpeuple de la prison, le cholera peut se developper a une vitesse effroyable' and 'C'est d'ailleurs le cholera qui a amene Medecins Sans Frontieres a la Maca pour la premiere fois, en 1993.' CONFLICT for Agent 5: '>400 detainees' (MSF 2003, contemporaneous) vs '>600 cases' (MSF 2008 retrospective, this row's source); not re-entered as a separate row.
